# orca-serve

Loaded on demand when working under `clis/orca-serve/`. The always-on rules live in the root `AGENTS.md`.

The Orca phone's wire served over rca: `orca-core` (the `Area` and `AgentApi` ports, `Host` dispatcher), `crypto` (handshake and sealed frames), one `map-<area>` crate per row group (each owns its methods list and maps them onto rca's agent API), and the `src/` composition root. Plan and row states: `docs/plans/rca-parity/plan.md`, `docs/plans/rca-parity/coverage/orca*.json`.

## Pin and copied data

The pin is `tooling/orca-conformance/orca-pin.json`. `map-state/src/defaults.json` is a copy of the pinned host's settings and UI defaults; `defaults.provenance.json` beside it records the pin commit, version and the file's sha256, and the map-state flow test fails when the pin moves or the copy is edited. After a pin bump, re-copy the defaults from `references/orca` at the new commit and update the provenance (`sha256sum src/defaults.json`).

## Tests

- Flow (`map-*/tests/flow.rs`): the area through `Host` with `ScriptedAgent` doubling rca. Assert whole answers (derive the expected object from `defaults.json`), never spot-check keys.
- Integration (`tests/integration/*_mNN.rs`): built binaries through the real rca-service and rca-exec, one file per milestone; each row counts only when its agent method answered in the call's window (method-hit trace).
- Recorded replay (`recorded_r1`, `mimic_*`): the real host's answers from `cassettes/`; a difference is an adapter bug listed in `known-gaps.json` until fixed.

## Coverage

`wf parity coverage --app orca --traces <dir|bundle>` rewrites the table from the chain's trace; `--check` fails on any problem. A row a trace names that the phone does not reach is either a decision (`orca-decisions.json` `decisions`, with a reason) or `traceNoise` with a reason; a mistyped row is fixed in the test. A `reverify` note holds a row pending until the answer does the work.
